_note: Public safety records (satsang-extensions 19 under the Satsang publication rule). Dry, attributed, dated; each with its primary reports.

records.subject: person/yogi-bhajan
records.summary: After December 2019 allegations (incl. Dyson's memoir), Yogi Bhajan's own organization commissioned An Olive Branch. Interviewing 299 people, the August 2020 report found it more likely than not that he engaged in sexual battery, sexual abuse, harassment and unethical conduct with 36 followers (1969–2004), with organizational enablers named. SSSC published it unedited.

reports.outlet: SSSC letter publishing the An Olive Branch report
Yoga Journal: A New Report Details Decades of Abuse

records.subject: person/taizan-maezumi
records.summary: Maezumi admitted alcoholism and sexual relationships with students in 1983 (Betty Ford rehab); his own organization later published findings, reforms and an ongoing atonement process.

reports.outlet: Tricycle: American Zen Community in Crisis (Cushman)

records.subject: person/sogyal-rinpoche
records.summary: After a July 2017 letter from eight former students, Rigpa commissioned an independent investigation (Lewis Silkin, led by Karen Baxter). The August 2018 report found, on the balance of probabilities, that some inner-circle students were subjected to serious physical, sexual and emotional abuse, and that senior Rigpa figures knew of some issues and failed to act. Not all allegations were upheld. Rigpa published the report and its boards' response.

reports.outlet: UK Charity Commission inquiry: Rigpa Fellowship
